title: Pharmacy Access Clause — RideLink Bonus Trips for Frequent Pharmacy Users
content:
Members who visit the pharmacy often receive bonus Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips, pharmacy being one of the value-added destinations.

**Clause.** Pharmacy bonus trips follow the member's pharmacy fill entries in the last six months, where a fill later reversed still counts because the pharmacy visit was made and a rejected fill is not a fill: at least the frequent-fill count of 12 adds the frequent pharmacy bonus of 4 trips to the year's value-added allotment; at least the regular-fill count of 6 but fewer than 12 adds the regular pharmacy bonus of 2 trips; fewer adds none.

The fill entries are those recorded on the member's Pharmacy Benefit with a fill date in the last six months.

## Fill bands

| Fill entries in the last six months | Pharmacy bonus trips |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 4 |
| 6 to 11 | 2 |
| 5 or fewer | None |

## Counting questions

- **Does a fill that was later reversed count?** Yes; the pharmacy visit was made.
- **Does a fill rejected at the counter count?** No; a rejected fill is not a fill.
- *Hypothetical:* 10 fills, of which 2 were later reversed, and 3 rejections in the last six months: 10 fills count, so 2 bonus trips.
- *Hypothetical:* 12 fills seven months ago and 5 fills in the last six months: 5 count, so no bonus.
